answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I played Imaginary Friend, then Duck and Cover, then Kaboom! targeting Nibbit, then Rapid Fire targeting Nibbit.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered omitting Duck and Cover, accepting 7 damage after Imaginary Friend's Block and preserving 1 Energy.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up all 2 Energy and consumed the 3 Sparks on the first Attack, rather than preserving those resources.
answers.q4_different_intent: Yes. If Nibbit had not telegraphed damage, I would have omitted Duck and Cover because its printed effect only provides Block.
